defect: The RPC resolver checked for a new creation reference before accepting its already verified mint-bound positive cache. The common router did not consult that cache at all for discoveries without a new reference. A different feed could therefore discard an original checked birth, then fall back to unavailable Birdeye creation access and retain missing_age.
